"You can copy and paste this prompt directly into your AI game maker app, Mr. Tucker:
AI Game Maker Prompt
Build a playable 2D turn-based monster-catching RPG modeled after classic Generation 5 handheld games, featuring a split-title screen where the player chooses between \"Rootin Tootin Bootin Black Version\" and \"what the hell Chewy White Version\".
Starter Selection @COMMENT_BODY@ Player Party
Let the player choose one of two starter dogs at the beginning of the game:
 * Bootin (Black Version Mascot): A white and tan terrier wearing a pink collar and standing inside oversized brown lace-up work boots.
 * Chewy (White Version Mascot): A black and tan dachshund-chihuahua mix wearing a collar and making a sideways side-eye face with his tongue sticking out.
   The player can hold up to 6 captured characters in their active party.
Wild Encounters (The Hot Dog Roster)
Battles take place in kitchen and concession stand arenas, including a glowing \"Nostalgia Electrics\" stainless steel hot dog roller grill. All wild enemies are hybrid dog-frankfurter creatures (\"Wiener Dogs\") withChewy's black-and-tan head, blue collar, and front paws fused onto a hot dog body. Include three distinct wild variants with different base catch rates (ranging from 45 to 255):
 * Roller Dog: A raw-to-sizzling frankfurter rolling on metal grill bars (Fire/Normal type).
 * Mustard Bun Dog: An evolved variant resting inside a white hot dog bun wrapped in a red napkin, topped with a yellow zigzag line of mustard (Fire/Condiment type).
 * Charred Grill Boss: A high-level, heavily toasted frankfurter with high defense.
Turn-Based Battle System @COMMENT_BODY@ 4-Move Loadout
Use a split-screen battle UI showing the player's active dog in the bottom-left, the wild Hot Dog in the top-right, and health bars with level and status indicators. On each turn, the player can choose Fight, Toy Bag, Party, or Run. Selecting Fight opens a 4-attack menu:
 * Timberland Stomp / Side-Eye Glare: High physical damage attack (Bootin stomps with work boots; Chewy delivers psychic confusion damage).
 * Mustard Squirt: Ranged attack that deals damage and has a 30% chance to apply a \"Sauced\" status condition (lowers enemy accuracy, 1.5x catch multiplier).
 * Roller Grill Spin: Fire-type spinning tackle that deals damage and has a 20% chance to inflict a \"Toasted\" burn status (2x catch multiplier).
 * Snack Beg: Status move that lowers the wild Hot Dog's defense and prevents it from fleeing.
Dog Toy Capture Mechanics (Pokeball Math)
Selecting Toy Bag lets the player throw a Dog Toy at the wild Hot Dog to recruit it to their team. Use the authentic Pokeball capture probability formula:

Include four tiers of throwable Dog Toys in the inventory:
 * Squeaky Tennis Ball (1x Multiplier): Standard Pokeball equivalent.
 * Rope Tug Toy (1.5x Multiplier): Great Ball equivalent.
 * Plush Fire Hydrant (2x Multiplier): Ultra Ball equivalent.
 * Golden Rawhide Bone (255x Multiplier): Master Ball equivalent; guarantees capture without fail.
When a toy is thrown, animate it bouncing off the Hot Dog and perform up to three shake checks before either locking in the capture (adding the Hot Dog to the player's usable party with its own 4 attacks) or breaking free if the roll fails.
If your game maker app supports uploading reference images directly alongside text, attach your three photos as the sprite references for the two starters and the wild encounter tiers. Would you like a shorter version of this prompt if the app has a strict character limit?

## Objective
- Complete a playable browser game based on the monster-catching RPG prompt.
- Make the dogs look more like dogs.

## Requirements
- Include Black/White version selection with Bootin and Chewy starters, parties of up to six, three hot-dog creature variants, turn-based battles, four moves, toy captures with three shake checks, and responsive controls.
- Improve the dog characters’ canine appearance.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with original art and no build dependencies.
- Draw the characters as inline SVGs with recognizable dog anatomy; preserve the hot-dog themes and Bootin’s boots.
- Capture odds factor in creature catch rate, HP, toy, and status effects.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game flow, battles, capture, encounters, status effects, party switching, controls, responsive layouts, and ending screen.
- Added Sauced’s accuracy reduction and Chewy’s Side-Eye Glare confusion effect.
- Reworked Bootin, Chewy, and hot-dog creature artwork into full-body SVG dogs with tails, muzzles, ears, legs, collars, and variant details.
- Added an inline favicon to avoid the prior `/favicon.ico` 404.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Visually verify the updated dog artwork in a browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Open the game in a browser and check the new SVG artwork across title, intro, and battle screens.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and inline favicon.
- `game.js`: Game logic and generated SVG dog artwork.
- `style.css`: Layout and SVG character styling.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked.
